footnote_text: These shares of Class A Common Stock are issuable upon vesting of a restricted stock unit ("RSU"). The RSUs vest upon the satisfaction of a service condition over a one year period commencing on November 1, 2026. The service condition is satisfied as to 1/4th of the shares on February 1, 2027 and as to an additional 1/4th of the shares for each three-month period of continuous service thereafter.
